svg.title: K20: a LimitRange fills in a memory limit nobody wrote
svg.desc: The Deployment YAML has no resources section. When the Pod is created, the namespace LimitRange default-memory fills in a request of 16Mi and a limit of 32Mi. The app needs about 56 MiB at start, 16 plus a 40 MiB preload, so the kernel kills it as soon as it crosses 32Mi, over and over. The fix is to write explicit resources in the YAML.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A namespace LimitRange silently gives every container without resources a default limit

svg.text: Nothing in the YAML showed the limit. It only exists in the Pod that actually ran.

svg.text: Pods restart again and again. describe pod: Last State Terminated, Reason: OOMKilled. The YAML shows no limit at all.

svg.text: Write resources in the Deployment: requests memory 64Mi, limits memory 128Mi. Explicit values beat namespace defaults.
